name: Original Request Information 1
definition: Set of characteristics that unambiguously identify the original global invoice financing request.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier of the original request message as assigned by the original sending party.

CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the original request message was created.

FinancingRequestor.name: Financing Requestor
FinancingRequestor.definition: Party that requests the invoice financing, on behalf of a creditor, as indicated in the original request message.

IntermediaryAgent.name: Intermediary Agent
IntermediaryAgent.definition: Financial institution that receives the request from the financing requestor and forwards it to the first agent for execution, as indicated in the original request message.

FirstAgent.name: First Agent
FirstAgent.definition: Financial institution of financing requestor to which an invoice financing request is addressed, as indicated in the original request message.

ValidationStatusInformation.name: Validation Status Information
ValidationStatusInformation.definition: Information about the validation status of the request message.

CancellationStatusInformation.name: Cancellation Status Information
CancellationStatusInformation.definition: Information on the business status of the cancellation.
